disagreements.reason: Only a dropped pronoun; meaning kept.
disagreements.slovak: Rozvinúť ho im trvá päť minút.
disagreements.answer: It takes five minutes to unroll it.

disagreements.slovak: Farebná girlanda spadla, lebo lepiaca páska bola príliš slabá. Úplná katastrofa!
disagreements.answer: The bright garland fell down since the tape was too weak. A total disaster!

disagreements.slovak: Fakt, učiteľka, máš toľko práce a stále ideš ďalej.
disagreements.answer: Really, teacher, you have so much work and you keep going.

disagreements.slovak: Prečo je piesok teplý? Lebo svieti slnko.
disagreements.answer: Why is the sand hot? Because the sun is shining.

disagreements.reason: 'give her hand' does not mean shake hands.
disagreements.slovak: Chce podať ruku svojmu kolegovi, lebo na podanie ruky treba dvoch ľudí.
disagreements.answer: She wants to give her colleague her hand, because you need two people for a handshake.

disagreements.slovak: Stoj! Tá drevená varecha je úplne plná omáčky!
disagreements.answer: Stop! That wooden spoon is totally covered in sauce!
